title: Azusa Pacific University (APU)
summary: Azusa Pacific University (APU) is a university in Azusa. This entry compiles College Scorecard figures and related sources; UniRepository is not affiliated with APU.

sections.heading: What APU is known for
paragraphs: Azusa Pacific University (APU) is a private nonprofit institution known for its significant focus on health-related programs, which constitute approximately 42.76% of its academic offerings. The university also offers business programs, accounting for about 8.37% of its curriculum. With an undergraduate enrollment of 2,759 students, APU maintains an admission rate of 88.43%, reflecting its accessibility to a broad range of applicants. These characteristics highlight APU's commitment to providing education in health and business fields within a private nonprofit framework.

sections.heading: How to read APU tuition
paragraphs: Azusa Pacific University (APU) charges a tuition fee of $44,458 for both in-state and out-of-state students. This uniform tuition rate simplifies the cost structure for all attendees regardless of residency status. The total cost of attendance, which includes tuition along with additional expenses such as fees, housing, meals, and other personal costs, amounts to $56,313. Understanding these figures helps prospective students and their families plan financially for the full scope of educational expenses at APU.

sections.heading: Financial aid
paragraphs: Azusa Pacific University (APU) offers financial aid options to assist students in managing the cost of attendance. Approximately 35.15% of students receive Pell Grants, which are federal subsidies aimed at supporting low-income students. Among those who complete their programs, the median debt incurred is $23,219, reflecting the typical borrowing amount to finance their education. Prospective students can explore detailed financial aid information and use the net price calculator available on APU's official website at www.apu.edu/. Additional data on financial aid and costs can also be accessed through the U.S. Department of Education's College Scorecard at https://collegescorecard.ed.gov/school/?109785.
